summary.intent: Turn the previously agreed M4 v2.0 closeout plan into concrete roadmap phases (74-78) using the /gsd-phase add-phase workflow, then link each M4 todo to the phase that resolves it, leaving non-M4 todos untouched.
summary.outcome: Added and enriched Phases 74-78 in ROADMAP.md, retired one todo that no longer needed a phase assignment, stamped `resolves_phase` on 28 M4 todos (10 non-M4 left untouched), updated milestone metadata/checklist and STATE.md's Roadmap Evolution via the GSD handler, and committed the change.

repo: cipher-box's /gsd-phase skill routes on the leading flag: no flag → add-phase (one integer phase at a time, can't batch-add a range like 74-78 in one call), --insert → decimal phase insertion, --remove → renumber, --edit → in-place field edit.
add-phase workflow only appends one phase per `gsd_run query phase.add` call — adding phases 74-78 required 5 sequential invocations.
STATE.md is protected by a protect-files.sh PreToolUse hook; updates must go through the GSD handler (`gsd_run query state.add-roadmap-evolution` / `state.patch`) rather than raw Edit/Write.
Each new phase directory created by phase.add contains only a `.gitkeep` until planned.
workflow: When mapping a todo backlog to new roadmap phases, do a final pass for todos missed in the original classification batch before invoking the phase-creation workflow — two were caught late here (`confirm-no-legacy-v1-v2-vault-blobs-on-auth-reenable`, `extract-assert-root-ownership-helper`).

After bulk-stamping a frontmatter field (e.g. `resolves_phase`) across many todo files via script, verify counts match the expected split (28 stamped vs 10 untouched) before proceeding, rather than trusting the script ran cleanly.

friction: The /gsd-phase add-phase workflow doesn't support adding a contiguous range of phases in one call, forcing 5 separate `phase.add` invocations plus manual enrichment (goal/success criteria/dependencies/resolved todos) as a follow-up edit pass rather than being generated correctly the first time.
User had to intervene mid-task to redirect one todo (the legacy vault-blob check) from being assigned to Phase 78 to being retired instead.
open_items: `confirm-no-legacy-v1-v2-vault-blobs-on-auth-reenable` was retired rather than assigned to a phase — confirm this is intentional and not silently dropped work.
10 non-M4 todos remain unmodified/unscoped as designed — will need their own phase mapping in a future milestone.
